findings.TITLE: Skip-then-attest recovery omitted durable prepare lock certificate
findings.DESCRIPTION: When a validator had already reserved a round-skip and later committed via a prepare quorum (recovery path journaling the attest at round+1), attestProposal wrote no lock-certificate file for the prepare round. requestViewChange then required peers to re-supply knownPrepares or failed with 'Locked commit is missing its prepare quorum'.
findings.ATTACK: After a skip-then-attest recovery, withhold prepare votes from the locked validator during a subsequent view-change. The honest node cannot prove its lock from durable local state alone.
findings.PRECONDITIONS: Validator previously skipped the round, then attested after a prepare quorum on the recovery path; lock-certificate store enabled (signing journal present).
findings.IMPACT: Liveness degradation / possible stuck view-change for honest recovery committers; safety of finality not directly broken, but lock accountability weakened after crash/restart without peer prepares.
findings.PROOF: l1/test/audit-skip-recovery-lock-cert.test.ts failed before fix (lock-certificates empty); passed after writing lock cert on skip recovery.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: attestProposal skip branch reserved recovery attestation but did not call writeLockCertificate (unlike the non-skip branch).
findings.FIX: Write lock certificate for block.header.round with the justifying prepares before reserveAttestation on the skip-recovery path.

findings.TITLE: LedgerState.fromGenesis allowed mining-tracker genesis allocation
findings.DESCRIPTION: Chain.validateGenesis correctly rejects MINING_TRACKER_ADDRESS allocations, but LedgerState.fromGenesis did not. Direct construction could credit the protocol-reserved tracker address, corrupting the miningClaimCount nonce semantics if nonce were later manipulated and creating inconsistent ledger snapshots.
findings.ATTACK: Feed a crafted genesis/snapshot path that uses LedgerState.fromGenesis without validateGenesis (tests, tooling, or future callers) and allocate to ZYN000…0.
findings.IMPACT: Defense-in-depth failure; potential mining-counter confusion if combined with other bugs. Production Chain.open path was already gated.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: Duplicate validation boundary; tracker ban only in validateGenesis.

findings.TITLE: Transfer amount+fee could overflow Number before apply-time rejection
findings.DESCRIPTION: assertAmount allows each of amountAtoms and feeAtoms up to MAX_SUPPLY_ATOMS. Their sum can exceed Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Apply paths rejected via !Number.isSafeInteger(total), but shape validation previously accepted the fields individually.
findings.ATTACK: Submit a transfer with amount=MAX_SUPPLY and fee=MAX_SUPPLY to stress mempool/validation paths.
findings.PRECONDITIONS: Ability to submit transactions to a node.
findings.IMPACT: DoS/noise and misleading errors; no silent mint observed (apply rejects). Hardened at shape boundary.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: Per-field caps without sum check at admission.
findings.FIX: Reject non-safe amount+fee sum in validateTransactionShape for transfers.

findings.TITLE: Consensus crypto (@noble/curves) was only a transitive dependency
findings.DESCRIPTION: secp256k1 consensus signing imported @noble/curves, but package.json listed it only via libp2p transitive deps. A networking-stack upgrade could silently change or remove the consensus crypto library.
findings.ATTACK: Supply-chain / dependency-resolution drift on libp2p upgrades.
findings.IMPACT: Consensus signature compatibility risk across nodes.
findings.PROOF: npm ls @noble/curves showed only transitive edges before pin; package.json lacked direct dependency.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: Consensus crypto not declared as a first-class dependency.
findings.FIX: Pin @noble/curves@2.3.0 as a direct dependency (same resolved version).
findings.TEST_ADDED: NOT TESTED (packaging change; existing crypto tests cover signing)

findings.TITLE: Prepare/view-change payloads embed domain then wrap again for protocol>=3
findings.DESCRIPTION: preparePayload/viewChangePayload include a domain field; protocol>=3 additionally wraps via signCanonicalDomain({domain,payload}). Create/verify are consistent, but remote signers must implement the double nesting exactly.
findings.ATTACK: None proven if LocalValidatorSigner and verifyForProtocol stay paired. Mis-implemented remote signer could refuse or produce unverifiable signatures.
findings.IMPACT: Operational footgun; not a verified safety break.
findings.PROOF: Code inspection; audit domain-separation test shows legacy bare sig fails under protocol 3 verification.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: Historical payload-embedded domain plus later domain wrapper.
findings.FIX: Document only for now; avoid changing wire format without a protocol bump.

findings.TITLE: State-v2 mining apply checks per-account balance, not explicit total supply
findings.DESCRIPTION: Legacy applyMining checks totalSupplyAtoms()+reward <= MAX_SUPPLY. State-v2 mining only checks miner nextBalance <= MAX_SUPPLY. Issuance schedule (assertMiningClaimContext) remains the authoritative historical cap.
findings.ATTACK: UNCERTAIN without corrupting genesisSupplyAtoms or bypassing assertMiningClaimContext.
findings.IMPACT: Defense-in-depth gap only under current call graph.
findings.PROOF: Code comparison of applyMining vs applyMiningClaimStateV2.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: Sparse Merkle apply lacks global supply accumulator.
findings.FIX: Optional: track cumulative supply or re-check schedule-issued+genesis in applyMiningClaimStateV2.
findings.TEST_ADDED: NOT TESTED (no exploit under current gates)

findings.TITLE: Permissioned PoA: N<=3 has f=0; mainnet decentralization not established
findings.DESCRIPTION: Quorum is floor(2N/3)+1 with f=floor((N-1)/3). For N=1,2,3 Byzantine fault tolerance is zero. Security is permissioned validator finality, not Nakamoto PoW consensus for block production.
findings.ATTACK: Compromise or withhold >f validators (any single validator for N<=3).
findings.PRECONDITIONS: Small validator set or correlated custody.
findings.IMPACT: Safety loss if Byzantine quorum; liveness halt if >f crash. Mainnet readiness blocker for decentralization claims.
findings.PROOF: Quorum arithmetic tests N=1..100; architecture review.
findings.FIX: Operational: require N>=4 independent operators before mainnet; document threat model. No consensus formula change proposed.

findings.TITLE: createRpcServer allows unauthenticated consensus if called without assertSafeRpcBinding
findings.DESCRIPTION: CLI enforces non-loopback => peer auth + trusted HTTPS proxy. Programmatic createRpcServer without peerAuthToken/trustedPeerPublicKeys accepts consensus writes from any TCP peer.
findings.ATTACK: Bind validator RPC on a reachable interface via custom embedding without auth options; flood prepare/attest/skip.
findings.PRECONDITIONS: Non-CLI embedding or misconfigured host binding bypassing assertSafeRpcBinding.
findings.IMPACT: Unauthorized signing-journal pressure / DoS against validator process; not remote key theft (signatures still need local journal+key).
findings.PROOF: preauthorizeConsensusRequest no-ops when both auth mechanisms unset; assertSafeRpcBinding only in CLI path.
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: Auth optional at library layer; safety pushed to CLI.
findings.FIX: REMAINING: fail-closed default in createRpcServer when host is non-loopback, or require explicit allowUnauthenticatedConsensus.

findings.TITLE: Unique-hash completion may commit without persisting a prepare quorum lock file
findings.DESCRIPTION: Comments and code allow unique-hash completion to commit without a prepare quorum; lock-certificate write is best-effort inside try/catch. A later view-change then depends on knownPrepares.
findings.ATTACK: Drive unique-hash completion then refuse to gossip prepares during view-change.
findings.PRECONDITIONS: Unique-hash completion path taken; prepares not durable.
findings.IMPACT: Liveness friction similar to ZC-AUD-001 for a narrower path. Prefer finalize the unique hash rather than view-change.
findings.PROOF: Code comment: 'Unique-hash completion may commit without a prepare quorum.'
findings.ROOT_CAUSE: S4 exception path without mandatory lock durability.
findings.FIX: REMAINING: if prepares exist, require durable lock cert; if not, forbid view-change until finality or document as finalize-only.

findings.TITLE: No independent formal verification of view-change state machine
findings.DESCRIPTION: Bounded search covers N=3,4,7 assignments but is not a complete model check. Author package explicitly says it is not an independent review.
findings.FIX: Commission independent consensus review + broader model checking before mainnet.
findings.TEST_ADDED: existing gate1/safety tests + audit adversarial suite
